full_prompt_en: A square, softly painted gothic portrait illustration shows a young woman in a high-necked black dress turned in profile toward the right, surrounded by pale flowers and dark birds. A muted sage-gray patterned field fills the background. Behind her head, thin nested oval lines create a light framing shape without separating her from the surrounding foliage. Her dark hair is drawn back into a low, elaborate bundle with black floral details at the rear. The face is pale and smoothly modeled, with a softly lit cheek, dark lashes, a straight nose, and slightly parted rose-colored lips. She looks toward the right edge with a calm, distant expression. The long neck emerges above a tall black collar, and the fitted dark garment fills the lower center. Subtle seams, a narrow diagonal band, and quiet gray highlights give the clothing some volume while preserving its nearly black mass. Around the figure, stems and muted green-gray leaves rise from the bottom and continue toward the upper corners. Large off-white blooms with dusky centers appear at the left, right, and lower edge, their petals described by delicate directional strokes. A dark bird crosses the upper right with wings spread and a pointed beak directed inward. Another flies at mid-right, and a third dark winged form appears near the lower left. Their small, sharp silhouettes contrast with the slow curves of the portrait and flowers. The palette remains restrained: cream, warm pale skin, charcoal, muted olive, faded gray, and small touches of pink. The painting has a fine matte surface and gently softened interior transitions, while the bird wings, hair ornaments, and garment edges retain more distinct outlines. Diffuse light from the upper left brightens the face and some pale petals, leaving the clothing and birds in deeper tones without strong cast shadows. No text is visible. The overall composition is ornamental and balanced, placing a luminous, still profile inside a closely woven field of flowers, foliage, and dark motion.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、柔和绘制的哥特气质肖像插画：年轻女子穿高领黑裙，以侧面朝右，周围环绕浅色花朵和深色飞鸟。低调的鼠尾草灰纹样铺满背景。她头后，几道纤细的同心椭圆线构成浅色框形，却没有把她从周围叶丛中割裂。深发向后收拢成复杂的低髻，后部点缀黑色花状细节。脸部浅白而塑形平滑，脸颊柔和受光，深色睫毛、笔直鼻梁与微张的玫瑰色嘴唇清楚可见。她望向右边缘，神情平静而疏离。修长脖颈从高高的黑领上方伸出，合身的深色衣服占据下方中央。细微衣缝、一道窄斜带和低调灰色亮部给衣服些许体积，同时保留它近黑色的大形块。人物周围，茎秆与灰绿色叶片从底部升起，并延向上方角落。带深灰花心的大朵米白花出现在左侧、右侧和下边缘，花瓣由纤细的定向笔触描绘。一只深色鸟在右上张翅掠过，尖喙朝向画内。另一只在右侧中部飞行，左下附近还有第三个深色翼形。它们小而锐利的剪影与肖像和花朵舒缓的曲线形成对照。配色克制，以奶油色、暖浅肤色、炭黑、低调橄榄绿、褪色灰和少量粉色为主。绘画表面细腻哑光，内部过渡轻轻柔化，鸟翼、发饰和衣服边缘则保留更清楚的轮廓。左上方的漫射光照亮面部和部分浅色花瓣，衣服与飞鸟维持更深色调，没有强烈投影。画中没有文字。整体构图富于装饰性且平衡，把明亮而静止的侧脸安置在花朵、叶丛和深色动态紧密编织的画面里。
style_prompt_en: Softly painted decorative illustration combines smooth, pale focal modeling with a densely interwoven field of muted organic curves. Near-black masses anchor the center and punctuate the perimeter, while cream and faded pink accents float forward from gray-green and sage surroundings. Fine directional strokes describe light surfaces; dark details receive more definite, crisp edges, creating a hierarchy between still broad forms and quick small silhouettes. Thin repeated ovals and curling lines provide quiet ornamental structure without flattening all depth. Diffuse light gently lifts selected pale areas, and the matte surface avoids glitter or sharp reflection. The overall mood is restrained and romantic, balancing graceful softness with small dark interruptions.
style_prompt_zh: 柔和绘制的装饰性插画把平滑的浅色焦点塑形与低调有机曲线交织成的密集画面结合。近黑色大块稳住中心并点缀外缘，奶油色与褪粉色重点从灰绿和鼠尾草色环境中浮出。纤细的定向笔触描绘浅色表面；深色细节获得更明确、更清楚的边缘，在静止的大形体与迅捷的小剪影之间建立层级。重复的细椭圆和卷曲线条提供安静的装饰结构，又不把所有纵深压平。漫射光轻轻提亮部分浅色区域，哑光表面避免闪烁和锐利反射。整体气氛克制而浪漫，在优雅的柔软感与少量深色扰动之间保持平衡。
theme_en: A dark-haired woman in profile among pale flowers and dark birds
theme_zh: 黑发女子的侧脸置于浅色花朵和深色飞鸟之间
name: Tom Bagshaw
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
